mixed_operator: C(X_U) D_i Theta_U D^i Theta_U, C=M_Pl^2/(2 X_U)
question: Does the explicit fixed-action mixed operator alter the principal two-derivative pure-TT kinetic or gradient coefficients on a homogeneous rolling scalar background?
required_checks: ADM lambda=1 kinetic principal quadratic form equals standard GR TT form
spatial Ricci principal quadratic form equals standard GR TT gradient form
D_i Theta_U vanishes identically in the pure TT sector with homogeneous lapse/scalar and zero invariant shift
P(X_U) contains no metric-derivative principal TT term
S_mix contains no principal TT term
scope: principal two-derivative pure-TT quadratic sector only; algebraic background mass terms, scalar/vector mixing away from pure TT, higher-spatial-derivative UV operators, radiative stability and compact-object sectors are excluded
pass_rule: all required checks exact and c_T_squared=1
guard: A PASS is a same-action IR TT principal theorem, not a full C7/C8/C9 completion or UV/radiative certificate.
